title: Database, migrations, health check and request logging

tasks.title: Postgres schema, migrations, migration rules and the integration test project
Health endpoint, the endpoint wrapper and structured request logging

acs.text: WHEN the migrations run against an empty database THE SYSTEM SHALL create the tables `rooms`, `room_members`, `shiurim`, `shiur_recordings`, `user_display`, `deleted_users` and `webhook_receipts`, with every timestamp column of type `timestamp with time zone` and every foreign key covered by an index whose leading columns are the key's columns.
scenarios: Migrations create the first tables with timezone timestamps and indexed foreign keys

acs.text: WHEN a migration file drops or renames a table or column, changes a column's type, or sets an existing column NOT NULL, and the file has no `-- contract:` line giving the reason, THE SYSTEM SHALL fail the migration check with a message naming the file and the statement (expand, deploy, contract).
scenarios: A destructive migration without a contract note is refused
A destructive migration with a contract note is allowed

acs.text: WHEN anyone calls `GET /api/v1/health` without a token and the database answers THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 200 with `{"status":"ok","database":"ok"}`, having called no service other than the database.
scenarios: Health is public and reports the database

acs.text: WHEN `GET /api/v1/health` is called and the database does not answer within 2 seconds THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 503 with `{"status":"unavailable","database":"unavailable"}`.

WHEN an API request completes THE SYSTEM SHALL write exactly one JSON log line with a static message, the method, the route template, the status, the duration in milliseconds and the correlation id, and SHALL NOT write any request header, the request body or the token.
scenarios: One structured log line per request, without secrets

acs.text: WHEN a request carries an `X-Correlation-Id` of 8 to 64 characters from `[A-Za-z0-9._-]` THE SYSTEM SHALL return the same value in the response's `X-Correlation-Id` header and log it; otherwise THE SYSTEM SHALL generate a new id and use it in both places.
scenarios: A valid correlation id is propagated
An invalid correlation id is replaced
